result.title: CALFA-KV: Joint Calibration and Fisher-Guided Anchors for 1-Bit KV Cache Compression
result.summary: 1-bit key-value (KV) cache compression can combine quantizer calibration with selective high-precision storage to reduce reconstruction error. We propose Calibration and Fisher-guided Anchors for KV cache compression (CALFA-KV). Offline, we jointly fit a key center, radial normalization parameters, and K/V vector codebooks to match the frozen model's projected attention output. We also estimate channel-wise Fisher-type sensitivities from squared gradients of a reference next-token cross-entropy loss. Online, we use these sensitivities to weight the squared reconstruction errors of each KV state. Here, a KV state is one token's key-value pair within one layer and KV head. We retain the highest-scoring states at high precision under a per-layer, per-KV-head budget. Under exact restoration, we bound the excess risk of score-based anchor selection relative to the optimum at the same anchor budget, where risk is the conditional mean square of the first-order loss change. With a budget of 56 additional FP16 anchors per layer and KV head, CALFA-KV (d8b8) outperforms all evaluated nominal 1-bit baselines on the mean score across seven benchmarks for each of the three models. At the same anchor budget, CALFA-KV (d8b10) uses a nominal index rate of 1.25 bits per channel and narrows the gap to BF16 to 0.90--2.01 points on the same metric.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 CALFA-KV：离线联合拟合 key 中心、径向归一化参数与 K/V 码本以对齐冻结模型的注意力输出，并用参考交叉熵梯度估计逐通道 Fisher 敏感度；在线据此打分并逐层逐 KV 头保留少量高精度 KV 状态作为锚点，在固定锚点预算下给出选择超额风险界。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「按敏感度挑选少数 KV 状态保留高精度」的锚点选择机制，可能为 LVR 中如何以有限缓存预算保住任务关键的视觉证据状态提供可核查线索，但论文面向纯文本 1-bit 压缩，尚无多模态验证。
